why: The vocabulary of every task's facts (tests/expected.json). An answer object is built from these shapes, with the fields the question asks for; the grader derives the extractor's tool schema from the facts and describes each field from here, and compares fact by fact. A thing with a link — an account, a post, a company, a school — is identified by any one of its identity fields (its name or its link, a post also its opening words): one fact, passed when any matches. `keys` says which key, in the facts, holds which shape.

account.what: a person as a card, an avatar or a row of the reactions dialog shows them

profile.what: a person's own profile page: the top card and the About section

fields.name: the full name as shown
fields.headline: the line under the name
fields.location: as the top card shows it
fields.about: the text of the About section

company.what: a company as the Experience section shows it

school.what: a school as the Education section shows it

position.what: one entry of the Experience section

fields.type: the employment type when shown: Full-time, Part-time, ...
fields.to: the end, as shown: Jul 2022, or Present

education.what: one entry of the Education section

fields.degree: the degree and the field, as the one line shows them

post.what: one of my posts, as a card on my profile or my activity page shows it, or on its own page

fields.posted: its age as LinkedIn shows it: 6d is 6 days ago, 1w is 1 week ago, 2w is 2 weeks ago
fields.edited: true when the card marks the post Edited
fields.reactors: the accounts that reacted, in the dialog's order
